feature.exponential_height_fog.density_h: How thick the fog is at its base.
feature.exponential_height_fog.height_fa: How quickly the fog thins with height.
feature.exponential_height_fog.height_he: World height above which the fog thins. Sanctuary lies at about 7900.
feature.exponential_height_fog.help: Fog that lies in low ground and thins with height, drawn over the finished scene in the game's own fog colour, with the sun glowing through it.
feature.exponential_height_fog.name: Exponential Height Fog
feature.exponential_height_fog.start_dis: Distance from the camera kept free of fog.
feature.exponential_height_fog.sun_aniso: How tightly the glow gathers around the sun. Positive is forward scattering.
feature.exponential_height_fog.sun_insca: How strongly the sun glows through the fog.
feature.exponential_height_fog.vanilla_f: How much of the game's own fog remains. One leaves it untouched.
feature.frame_counter.help: Counts rendered frames and reports the count to the log.
feature.frame_counter.name: Frame Counter
feature.frame_trace.help: Diagnostic. Writes one frame of the engine's shader calls to the log, with what each had bound, when the key is pressed.
feature.frame_trace.name: Frame Trace
feature.imagespace_tint.help: Replaces an imagespace pixel shader with one of our own.
feature.imagespace_tint.name: Imagespace Tint
feature.screen_space_shadows.bilinear_th: Depth difference at which an edge stops being smoothed across.
feature.screen_space_shadows.help: Contact shadows from the sun, ray marched through the depth buffer. Adds the fine shadows a shadow map is too coarse to carry.
feature.screen_space_shadows.name: Screen-Space Shadows
feature.screen_space_shadows.sample_coun: Multiplier for the number of samples along a ray. Higher reaches further and costs more. Scales with the render resolution.
feature.screen_space_shadows.shadow_cont: How hard the transition into shadow is. Higher gives sharper edges.
feature.screen_space_shadows.surface_thi: How thick surfaces are assumed to be. Lower gives thinner, more precise shadows; too high and everything casts one.
feature.shader_census.help: Counts the techniques of the engine's thirteen shader classes and reports what the deferred passes have bound. A diagnostic with no effect on the picture: it patches the engine's shader tables while it runs, and it has nothing left to say once it has reported.
feature.shader_census.name: Shader Census
feature.shader_census.names: Ask the engine for technique names
feature.shader_census.names_help: Calls the engine's own GetTechniqueName for every technique found, which is a call into the game rather than a read of it. Turn it off if the census does not survive a run.
menu.restore_confirm: Put every setting back to its default?
menu.title: Community Shaders
performance.frame_note: Frame is wall time between presents; passes are exact.
performance.title: Performance
setting.menu.font_size.help: Size of the text in this overlay.
setting.performance.hud.help: Draws a small display while this overlay is closed.
setting.performance.log_key.help: Writes the current numbers to the plugin log.
setting.performance.measure.help: Times each pass on the CPU and the GPU. Off issues no queries at all.
